newsitem.title: ITALY: Autogrill 1996 profits up, but no dividend.
newsitem.headline: Autogrill 1996 profits up, but no dividend.

text.p: Italian group Finanziaria Autogrill, the holding company that controls roadside restaurant chain Autogrill SpA, on Tuesday reported increased profits for 1996, but it gave no dividend payout.
The company said in a statement that a board meeting today had examined the 1996 results and "to sustain the progress of investments already announced" had decided not to pay a dividend for 1996.

The board meeting was also called to approve the merger between Finanziaria Autogrill, Autogrill SpA and Schemaventidue SpA. The three companies have requested a Milan stock market listing for the merger company.

Finanziaria Autogrill said its 1996 operating profits rose to 87.5 billion lire, up 17 percent from 1995's 74.8 billion lire, on annual turnover up six percent to 1.71 trillion lire from 1995's 1.61 trillion lire.
Net consolidated profits for the year were 62.3 billion lire against 43.7 billion lire in 1995, said Autogrill.
